instruction: Duplex townhouse IFC model. Create a two-storey duplex townhouse block from scratch in Revit and export the completed model to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using the IFC4 schema. The building should read as two mirrored dwelling units. The IFC must contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, two IfcBuildingStorey entities, ten IfcSpace room objects, sixteen IfcWall elements, two IfcSlab elements, and one IfcRoof. Name the rooms so the model includes at least two Living spaces, two Kitchen spaces, four Bedroom spaces, and two Bath spaces. Include at least ten IfcDoor elements, eight IfcWindow elements, and two IfcStair elements connecting the two storeys. Do not include IfcBuildingElementProxy, IfcColumn, or IfcBeam entities. The shaped model's overall bounding box should span 14.5-17.5 m in X, 9.0-11.5 m in Y, and 6.0-8.5 m in Z. Other residential layout details may vary as long as the exported BIM elements satisfy these requirements and all IfcRoot GlobalIds are unique. [Software] Launch Revit with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`.
